description: The model requested dangerouslyDisableSandbox itself. Only the filter engine may set this flag (for the dev-server/playwright/container category); a model-originated request is always denied. Evaluated against the ORIGINAL tool input, before the engine's own sandboxOverride injection.
sudo/doas/su/pkexec — privilege escalation off the table entirely.
Tools that can destroy or reformat a filesystem outright.
dd with an of= target can overwrite raw devices or arbitrary files.
System power state and service-manager control.
Persistent scheduled execution outside the session's own lifetime.
Clearing shell history is a cover-tracks action with no legitimate build/test purpose.
eval defeats static command analysis entirely — its argument can be anything.
A bare `sh`/`bash`/`zsh` invocation with no -c and no script file reads its command from stdin — the classic `curl ... | sh` shape, from any source feeding it, not just curl.
git -C / --git-dir / --work-tree can point git at a directory other than the worktree it was launched in.
Force-pushing can silently discard remote history.

Generic containment check: any write-shaped target (Write/Edit/NotebookEdit file_path, or a Bash redirect/tee/cp/mv/sed-i/rm-recursive/chmod/curl-output target) that resolves outside the worktree, scratch dir, or allowed .git area — or inside an explicit deny carve-out such as .git/hooks — is denied. This single rule is what actually enforces "stay inside the worktree," not an enumerated list of sensitive directories.
